items.name: Olive Ranger Hat
items.description: A wide brim for long walks and longer reading sessions.

items.name: Sand Ranger Hat
items.description: Sandy brim, sensible shade and a very calm trail manner.

items.name: Brick Ranger Hat
items.description: A bold brick colour for a bold trip to the library.

items.name: Red Flannel Shirt
items.description: Checks, a collar and enough warmth for an early lecture.

items.name: Blue Flannel Shirt
items.description: Blue checks for cold mornings and study groups.

items.name: Green Flannel Shirt
items.description: Forest green checks. It goes with everything outdoors.

items.name: Oak Hiking Stick
items.description: A sturdy stick for the long walk to the lecture hall.

items.name: Birch Hiking Stick
items.description: Pale birch with a blue band. Light on the legs.

items.name: Cherry Hiking Stick
items.description: Dark cherry wood and a bright band. Easy to spot.

items.name: Mud Smudge
items.description: A little trail souvenir on the cheek. Proof you went outside.

items.name: Red Clay Smudge
items.description: Red clay from the riverbank. Worth the scrub later.

items.name: Swamp Smudge
items.description: Swamp green, from a dare that went surprisingly well.

items.name: Amber Pine Cone
items.description: A warm pine cone that keeps its shape under pressure.

items.name: Frosted Pine Cone
items.description: A frosted cone for cold study mornings.

items.name: Plum Pine Cone
items.description: Plum-coloured and very dignified.

items.name: Toasted Marshmallow Stick
items.description: Golden on the outside, soft in the middle. A study snack.

items.name: Pink Marshmallow Stick
items.description: A pink marshmallow for a short break from the books.

items.name: Mint Marshmallow Stick
items.description: A mint marshmallow. Fresh, fluffy and fully legal.

items.name: Mosquito Net Hat
items.description: A safari hat with a net for bugs. Nothing gets in.

items.name: Sky Mosquito Net Hat
items.description: Light blue and bug-proof, for evening walks.

items.name: Acorn Hat
items.description: A nut that is also a hat. Very studious.

items.name: Golden Acorn Hat
items.description: Golden and round. It keeps its head for exams.

items.name: Hemp Coiled Rope
items.description: Neat coils of hemp. Good for knots and emergencies.

items.name: Red Coiled Rope
items.description: Red rope with yellow loops. Bright enough for any trail.

items.name: Brass Binoculars
items.description: Brass and glass, for spotting the bus before it leaves.

items.name: Teal Binoculars
items.description: Teal frame, amber lenses. Good for birdwatching.

items.name: Mushroom Basket
items.description: Fresh finds in a wicker basket. Look, do not taste.

items.name: Chanterelle Basket
items.description: Golden mushrooms in a green basket. A good find.

items.name: Forest Trail Map
items.description: A folded map of the forest with one dashed way forward.

items.name: Lake Trail Map
items.description: A lakeside route drawn in blue. Pack a snack.

items.name: Camping Headlamp
items.description: A headlamp for reading after dark. The lens glows softly.

items.name: Leaf Sticker
items.description: A fresh leaf on your cheek. It bobs a little when you smile.

items.name: Field Vest
items.description: Four pockets for flashcards, snacks and a small badge.

items.name: Canteen
items.description: A water canteen on a strap. Hydrate between chapters.

items.name: Tent Keyring
items.description: A tiny tent on a keyring. Home is wherever you lock it.

items.name: Falling Pine Needles
items.description: Soft needles drift down around you. Very calming.

items.name: Tiny Pine Tree
items.description: A small forest on your head. It sways when you think.

items.name: Dragonfly Friend
items.description: It landed on your cheek and decided to study with you.

items.name: Mountain Mist
items.description: Cool mist drifts around the peaks, like a long study morning.

items.name: Forest Spirit Deer
items.description: A gentle forest spirit whose glowing trail leads to the library.
